intro.text: A battalionlord commanding the Fifth Battalion of the Kholin army on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Dalinar asked Havrom to gather the soldiers in his camp whom Sadeas had questioned about the cut strap on Elhokar's saddle. Havrom saw that the orders were carried out and that his battalion was in good order when Dalinar and Adolin arrived.

appearance.text: Built like a tower, he wears a long beard with a clean-shaven chin, a Horneater style he keeps because of some Unkalaki ancestry.

personality.text: He holds his officers and soldiers to the Kholin army's high standards.
